items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: And Dutre. Honorary Dutre. I know Sam Dutre.

ctx.x: He used to call him horse. Yeah, he called a horse.

Yeah. He used to call him horse. He used to call him horse. He used to call him horse. And I was talking about Manuel. I said I'd like to see Manuel. I hadn't seen him in a long time. And when they'd go play, they'd play out of the lake and come back, they'd grab him in the rainboard and George would be just coming home and sitting on Louisiana Avenue car and go to sleep.
